verdict.rationale: Browser Use documents stealth Chromium, residential proxies and automatic CAPTCHA solving, so the question applies. However, the evidence pack contains no published acceptable-use policy, anti-abuse terms, or rules on what these features may be used for. SOC 2 and HIPAA badges are compliance attestations, not a usage-governance posture, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an automation-engineer, I can point to the vendor's published acceptable-use and anti-abuse posture governing what its stealth and automation features may be used for
